mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_feedback (session_id, agent_id, assistant_message_id, feedback_type, rating, message, correction, source_type, category, matched_case_id, resolved, status, submitted_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{agentId}, #{assistantMessageId}, #{feedbackType}, #{rating}, #{message}, #{correction}, #{sourceType}, #{category}, #{matchedCaseId}, #{resolved}, #{status}, #{submittedBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_feedback WHERE id=#{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM ai_feedback ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_feedback WHERE DATE(created_at)=CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_feedback WHERE resolved=#{resolved}
SELECT * FROM ai_feedback WHERE agent_id=#{agentId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM ai_feedback WHERE agent_id=#{agentId} AND source_type='EXPLICIT' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_feedback WHERE agent_id=#{agentId} AND source_type='EXPLICIT'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_feedback WHERE agent_id=#{agentId} AND source_type='EXPLICIT' AND DATE(created_at)=CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_feedback WHERE agent_id=#{agentId} AND source_type='EXPLICIT' AND (feedback_type='THUMBS_DOWN' OR (rating IS NOT NULL AND rating <= 2))
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_feedback SET status=#{toStatus}, category=CASE WHEN #{category}='' THEN category ELSE #{category} END, matched_case_id=CASE WHEN #{matchedCaseId}='' THEN matched_case_id ELSE #{matchedCaseId} END, resolved=#{resolved}, updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND agent_id=#{agentId} AND status=#{fromStatus}
